grader.scenario: Mobile roaming data not connecting in Spain despite roaming bolt-on active
grader.notes: Exemplary customer service and technical troubleshooting call. Daniel validates the customer's travel anxiety, methodically verifies account security and roaming provisioning, guides Abigail to update her outdated APN settings, and verifies full 5G connectivity in Spain.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Opening greeting at [00:00] and closing script at final turn.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: One managed hold announced at [02:50] and thanked at [03:52].

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified UK address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Addressed Abigail by name naturally throughout.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Hard-case PASS: Handled customer's distress upon landing without data warmly at [00:23] ('I completely understand how stressful it is to arrive in Spain and find yourself without data for maps or hotel bookings, Abigail').

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Accurately restated problem at turn 10: 'So what I am hearing is that you have landed in Valencia with your active Euro Roam Pass, but although you have signal, your mobile data and applications aren't connecting. Have I understood the problem accurately?'

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Listened attentively without repeating any previously stated questions.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Took full end-to-end ownership of resolving the roaming connection.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Maintained a supportive and professional tone throughout.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Probed into handset OS, data roaming toggles, carrier signals, and APN settings.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Confirmed 5G signal, Google Maps route loading, and web browsing.
